Your booking is confirmed. Please note that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Regarding arrival, no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. The amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.

^1 See terms for pool access.
^2 Guide fees apply separately.

Comparison: Selected offer Alder vs. Distractor Birch. For the Alder package, cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. A guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. A swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. The amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Note: The unbooked offer policy for activity states the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay, but this belongs to the unselected Birch offer.

Agent Notes: Critical conflict detected. Refund: Cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Arrival: Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. Facility: The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Activity: Two equally current and authoritative policies disagree. Neither overrides the other. Applicable terms are unresolved. One policy states the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay, while the other states the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.

Package Comparison: Selected stay is 8–15 May. Distractor applies exclusively to December stays. For the selected May dates, cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. A guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. A swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. Note: The other dates policy for activity claims the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment, but this is irrelevant to the current booking.
